title: Brightwell 2027 · Pet Lovers drinkware
brief:
# Brightwell Home & Gift - 2027 drinkware programme: PET LOVERS (RFQ BH-SR-2611)

Brightwell Home & Gift is sourcing drinkware for our 2027 programme. Our theme this season is PET LOVERS: dogs, cats and pet owners, in gift-ready packaging. We also consider closely related animal and everyday designs that could be adapted to a pet theme.

Please reply by email with the products you can offer. For EACH product, please include:
1. Item number and product name
2. Drinkware type (travel cup, coffee mug, tumbler, pint glass, wine glass, gift set)
3. Dimensions (W x L x H) and weight
4. Materials (main body, lid or other parts)
5. Care instructions (dishwasher, microwave, hand wash)
6. Artist or designer of the artwork, and any licence limits
7. Packaging (gift box, colour box, open stock) and capacity
8. Theme, colour and season
9. Country of origin
10. Unit price in USD, price terms (Incoterm) and validity
11. Minimum order quantity (MOQ) in pieces
12. Production lead time and shipping time to the US
13. Sample policy and cost
14. Compliance documents (FDA, LFGB, Prop 65, lead and cadmium)
Photos of each item are very helpful.

Please send your reply by 6 November 2026. We will follow up with questions on anything missing.

How we judge offers (stated by the PD team):
- Hard requirement: the product is drinkware (a cup, mug, tumbler or glass, or a gift set built around one). An offer that is not drinkware does not meet spec.
- Not hard requirements, but weigh them: pet theme (dogs, cats, pet owners) or an animal/everyday design that could be adapted to it; gift-ready packaging; compliance documents (FDA, LFGB, Prop 65, lead and cadmium); artwork licence valid for our sales channels.
- Prices in USD are preferred; a quote in another currency or Incoterm is accepted but must be stated clearly.
